title: Lazur and ChatGPT on Mac: when to use which
metaTitle: Lazur vs using ChatGPT on Mac: which job each does
description: ChatGPT on Mac and Lazur side by side: ChatGPT for long chats and files, Lazur for quick questions about your screen and typing by voice in any app.
intro: ChatGPT on Mac is great for long conversations and files. Lazur is for the moment you are in another app: hold ⌥ ⌘, ask about what is on screen, and get an answer out loud without switching windows.
tldr: Use ChatGPT for long research chats, file uploads and projects.
Use Lazur for quick questions about the app you are in. It sees your screen while you hold ⌥ ⌘.
Hold fn in the ChatGPT box to dictate long prompts with Lazur.

demos.spoken: compare these two plans on screen, which one is cheaper for five people?
demos.result: The Team plan works out cheaper for five people. The other one charges per seat above three.

demos.spoken: write a brief for a landing page for a pottery class, friendly, under 200 words, include the price and the Saturday times
demos.result: Typed the prompt into the ChatGPT message box.
demos.output: Write a brief for a landing page for a pottery class. Friendly tone, under 200 words. Include the price and the Saturday times.

asks.result: Explains the chart on screen out loud.

asks.say: research standing desks under $300 in the background
asks.result: Runs the research in Chrome tabs and comes back with a report.

asks.say: remind me to send the brief at 5

asks.result: Reads the page on screen and gives you the gist.
Writes the reply at your cursor.

rows: Have a long back and forth, upload files
Ask about the app you are in right now
Find a button in an unfamiliar app
Write a long prompt without typing

blocks.text: Many people use both. Lazur is often the faster way to talk to the window in front of you, including the ChatGPT window.

faq.question: Is Lazur built on ChatGPT?
faq.answer: Lazur uses AI models from providers to answer. It is a separate Mac app and is not affiliated with OpenAI.

faq.question: Can I use Lazur to talk to ChatGPT?
faq.answer: Yes. Click the ChatGPT message box, hold fn and talk. Lazur types the prompt for you.

faq.question: Do I need both?
faq.answer: No. If you mostly want quick help inside other apps, Lazur alone covers it. If you live in long chats, keep ChatGPT too.
